decisions.resolution: Enterprise policy authority and broad feature actor eligibility do not establish repository-content or custom-pattern dry-run permission. Preserve effective permission evidence independently.

Organization membership is not organization ownership or repository administration. Dry-run applicability requires exact target administration and the documented organization-role condition, without automatically elevating the actor.

Retain ghec-only SAML and SCIM joining paths. The ability to join or become an owner is not authority to change identity-provider assignment, membership, credentials or role. Existing sanctioned access must be used; unavailable access remains unknown.

assessment_contract.target_identity: Exact enterprise, organization, repository, actor and pattern revision
assessment_contract.evidence: Current role and effective repository-administration readback, product/version applicability, creator restrictions and identity-provider constraints where applicable
assessment_contract.unknown: An inaccessible endpoint or missing role readback cannot PASS or prove nonexistence
assessment_contract.human_required: Membership, IdP assignment, role escalation or credential changes require their applicable explicit approval; do not implement them as automatic collector repair
assessment_contract.behavior_boundary: A valid role readback does not itself prove successful dry run, published-pattern state or effective push blocking

additional_dependency_observation.observation: The one-line include is screenshot alt text and an image reference for a gear dropdown; it adds no role grant or enforcement assertion.
